subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, an in-TUI setting, or a changed CLI default with explicit opt-out?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally frame provider delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
options.body: Add the chosen default through the canonical schema/docs/tests path with explicit flag precedence and no hidden compatibility alias.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery as an explicit per-session launch flag and close or document the ergonomics request after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Change the CLI default
options.body: Make delivery on by default only if maintainers intentionally accept the compatibility and outbound-message behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
recommendation.body: Add the chosen default through the canonical schema/docs/tests path with explicit flag precedence and no hidden compatibility alias.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is primarily a TUI/default product choice, and steipete is tied to the original TUI surface and current launch/config lines.
